identification: Australian 1933 florin (George V, Melbourne Mint, the key-ish low mintage GV florin date, 1,080,000 struck) in a 2x2 card holder, grade by photo about Fine (King's hair and crown band worn, legends full, reverse emu feathers and shield partly worn; even grey toning, no obvious cleaning or edge knocks visible). Plus a 1942 Melbourne (no mintmark) threepence, about Fine to VF. Holders hand-labelled by the vendor 'scarce date, low mintage, strong reverse' with numbers (34) and (51). Lot page: estimate A$40-60, current bid A$25.
